name: skipper-cd-ui-static
description: Dev-only formatting/linting for the embedded UI's plain-script JS (app.js, app-state.js, app-panels.js, app-autosync.js, app-logs.js, app-clog.js, app-render.js, app-helpers.js, sw.js) and its node --test unit layer. Never shipped in the binary — see ADR-0035 (self-contained, no build step, no bundler for the app itself).

scripts.fmt: prettier --write app.js app-state.js app-panels.js app-autosync.js app-logs.js app-clog.js app-render.js app-render.test.js app-helpers.js app-helpers.test.js sw.js
scripts.fmt:check: prettier --check app.js app-state.js app-panels.js app-autosync.js app-logs.js app-clog.js app-render.js app-render.test.js app-helpers.js app-helpers.test.js sw.js
scripts.lint: eslint app.js app-state.js app-panels.js app-autosync.js app-logs.js app-clog.js app-render.js app-render.test.js app-helpers.js app-helpers.test.js sw.js
